summary.text: Jen Plumb is a Democratic state senator from Utah who has represented District 9 since January 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an emergency physician who teaches at the University of Utah.

paragraphs.text: Jen Plumb, listed by Ballotpedia as Jennifer Plumb, earned a high school diploma from East High School, a B.S. from the University of California, Los Angeles in 1993, and an MPH in 1996 and an MD in 2000, both from the University of Utah.
Her career includes work as an emergency physician and professor at the University of Utah and Primary Children's Hospital Pediatric Emergency Medicine.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was first elected in 2022, is a pediatric emergency medicine physician at Primary Children's Hospital, and co-founded Utah Naloxone, where she serves as medical director.
She said her legislative priorities include public health, injury prevention, child welfare, and policies grounded in data and community impact.
